notes: Day 1 replacement run 33483023566 measured main SHA 745018e2dc5115b65faf3fb363d677fd411dee6a and returned partial evidence: 315 candidates, 246 ranked, 69 duplicates, 0 expired and one HTTP 403 source failure.

Day 1 ranked evidence also exposed AX CTA/FAQ/navigation noise, so direct offer-detail extraction is being bounded to the page H1 and common UI noise is rejected.

Active Ageing returned HTTP 403. Ziras will not bypass that technical control; the source is demoted to research-only and a bounded GO Kartanzjan public offer source is the POC senior-benefit replacement.
The POC source-type metric is corrected to count distinct source_class values, not distinct source_key values.
Merchant onboarding is explicit machine evidence at zero because the POC ingestion path has no merchant-onboarding dependency.
Each daily ingestion artifact will include a deterministic audit template for usefulness, valid-open and relevance review; missing review labels continue to fail closed.
The bounded schedule moves from 08:00 to 08:07 Europe/Malta after the Day 1 top-of-hour schedule did not fire; scope remains POC-only and the date guard remains 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-14.
Previous VS-07 certifications remain historical evidence but are stale for this runtime amendment until a fresh exact-head certification passes.
Production source access remains OFF and release/production enablement remain not authorized.
